content.user_title: Create SEO Content with Brand Voice
content.value_statement: Teams need marketing content that ranks well and still sounds consistent. This skill combines brand voice guidance, SEO checks, and channel templates for repeatable content creation.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes local text for readability, sentence variety, and brand voice signals.
Reviews drafts for keyword density, heading structure, links, and SEO recommendations.
Provides blog, case study, email, social post, and video content frameworks.
Guides platform-specific social content length, hashtags, timing, and accessibility checks.
Supports content calendar planning with a reusable monthly template.
limitations: Does not perform live keyword research or verify current search volume.
Does not publish, schedule, or manage posts inside external platforms.
Requires user-provided drafts, keywords, brand inputs, or campaign goals.
Does not replace legal, medical, financial, or regulated content review.

use_cases.title: Plan a Monthly Content Program
use_cases.description: Create themes, channel assignments, and draft priorities using the calendar template and content pillar guidance.

use_cases.title: Adapt One Message Across Channels
use_cases.description: Turn a core campaign idea into blog, email, LinkedIn, Instagram, and short video formats.

use_cases.title: Improve a Draft Before Publishing
use_cases.description: Check SEO structure, keyword use, readability, voice consistency, and practical next-step recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Blog Outline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a structured first draft plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the content-creator skill to outline a 1,500 word blog post about [topic] for [audience]. Include the primary keyword [keyword], three section headings, and a clear call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Brand Voice
prompt_templates.scenario: Review existing copy before writing related content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the brand voice analyzer guidance on this sample: [paste sample]. Identify the dominant voice, readability level, sentence pattern, and three changes for more consistent brand tone.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize an Existing Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve SEO and structure before publication.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the SEO optimizer workflow to review this draft for [primary keyword] and secondary keywords [keywords]. Return priority fixes for title, headings, keyword density, links, meta description, and readability.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Cross-Channel Campaign
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning across blog, email, and social channels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the content frameworks, social media guidance, and calendar template to create a four-week campaign for [product]. Include weekly themes, channel formats, repurposing steps, success metrics, and brand voice rules.

output_examples.input: A draft article about customer onboarding with the keyword onboarding software.
output_examples.output: SEO review with an optimization score, keyword density notes, missing heading issues, meta description ideas, and prioritized edits.

output_examples.input: A brand voice sample from a SaaS homepage.
output_examples.output: Voice profile covering formality, tone, perspective, readability, sentence variety, and recommendations for consistent future copy.

output_examples.input: A campaign brief for a new product launch.
output_examples.output: A four-week content plan with blog topics, social adaptations, email angles, posting guidance, and measurable campaign goals.

best_practices: Provide audience, brand voice, offer, keyword, and channel details before requesting content.
Review SEO recommendations together with reader value and brand consistency.
Adapt each draft to the target platform instead of reposting identical copy.
anti_patterns: Publishing generated content without fact-checking claims, links, and compliance requirements.
Forcing keywords until the content sounds unnatural or repetitive.
Using one generic brand voice for every audience, funnel stage, and channel.

faq.question: Can this skill write complete marketing drafts?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide outlines, drafts, rewrites, and platform adaptations when you provide topic, audience, and goals.

faq.question: Does it perform live SEO keyword research?
faq.answer: No. It works best with keywords and search data that you provide from your preferred SEO tool.

faq.question: Can it analyze brand voice from existing content?
faq.answer: Yes. The local analyzer reviews readability, tone signals, perspective, and sentence structure from supplied text.

faq.question: Does it post content to social media platforms?
faq.answer: No. It creates and optimizes content plans, but publishing and scheduling happen outside the skill.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code users?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides prompts, references, and local scripts that can support writing workflows in those tools.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide audience details, brand rules, primary keyword, target channel, product context, and any draft text.
